name: helios
description: Make videos from code: preview them in the chat, then render frame-exact MP4s on your computer.
long_description: Ask Claude for a video and it writes one HTML page that draws each frame from its time. Helios plays it in the conversation, so you can scrub it and click what you want changed, then renders a frame-exact MP4 on your computer with headless Chrome. Needs Node.js 20 or newer.

tools.name: preview_video
tools.description: Play a video page in the chat, with a scrubber

tools.name: verify_video
tools.description: Check that every frame depends only on its time

tools.name: render_video
tools.description: Render the MP4 on your computer

root.title: Video folder
root.description: Where Helios saves video pages and renders.
